verdict.rationale: kitty's first-party ssh kitten sets up the remote environment "as comfortable as your local shell", with automatic shell integration, file transfer, connection reuse and forwarding of remote-control sockets. That squarely covers the core of the story. Community complaints about copying terminfo and TERM breaking nano describe plain ssh use, not a failure of the kitten, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that terminfo is carried automatically, explicit documentation of copying local config/dotfiles to the remote, and independent hands-on corroboration of the ssh kitten.
